title: Datadew Valley

sections.heading: About the project
sections.text: Datadew Valley is a research project at Brown University about what it is like to live next to a data center. It invites people who use AI tools every day to spend a few minutes in the shoes of a community that hosts the infrastructure behind them.

sections.heading: A note on Datadew Valley
sections.text: Datadew Valley is not a real place, and it is not modeled on any single town. It is a composite: each part of the story, from the brown well water and rising bills, draws from real reporting and research about communities living next to data centers across the United States. The people you meet, like Alex, Ruth and Councilmember Johnson, are fictional, but their experiences reflect reality. The sources for each fact are listed at the bottom of the pop-up where it appears.
